title: AssassEffects
description: This Project Adds Effects to People During PvP Depending on Kill/Death.
body:
**AssassEffects requires [OpenJavascript](https://modrinth.com/plugin/openjavascript)**!

# AssassEffects

AssassEffects is a simple **PvP plugin** for your server. The premise is simple:

Kill -> Positive Effect;

Death -> Negative Effect.

Dying with a positive effect leads to said effect's removal. Killing a player with a negative effect leads to said effect's removal. You can have up to 8 positive or negative effects simulataneously (but the two types cannot mix).

Positive Effects:

- Saturation
- Resistance
- Strength
- Speed
- Luck
- Hero Of The Village
- Water Breathing
- Haste

Negative Effects:

- Slowness
- Glowing
- Hunger
- Slow Falling
- Nausea
- Bad Omen
- Weakness
- Mining Fatigue

Effects Cannot Be Negated Via Milk Bucket, or Death. They Are Infinite Until You Kill, or Die.

## Commands

Permission (All): `assasseffects.use`

1. `/ae help` -> Help Message
2. `/ae re <player> <effect>` -> Remove Effect from Player
3. `/ae ue <player> <effect` -> Use/Apply Effect on Player
